answer.revision: India stands outside world history (shaken): the tombs persist as a record of the universal will, even if the state that raised them is dissolved.
answer.thought: The air is too heavy for the bungalow, and my stomach is a hollow drum. I shall walk to Lodhi Gardens; the domes there are the only architecture that has survived the turning of ages, a testament to the fact that the universal will leaves a mark even when the particular state perishes. I have no money for food, but the walk will sustain me.
